main_tables.caption: Table 1. Error and exposure support in high-fire-proxy months during fixed-window future evaluation. High-fire months exceed the 90th percentile of the outer-training regional fire feature. Errors are in µg m⁻³; signed bias is predicted minus observed. N/sites denotes P90 station-months/physical stations. Support columns show retained rows/sites (percentage of P90 rows); both rules combine the 50-km distance screen with bounds on non-geographic features. All-month and stratum-specific results and excluded counts are in Supplementary Tables S11–S12.

Table 2. Matched future comparison with a fitted B+CAMS model. Primary source policies, strict QA, log-smear/smearing and fixed historical training cutoff. RMSE and differences are in µg m⁻³. Positive B+CAMS minus full differences favor the full model. Brackets give conditional intervals from resampling physical stations; these comparator intervals are outside the 78-contrast multiplicity family. All fixed country-years and both profiles are reported.

supplementary_tables.caption: Supplementary Table S5. Spatial validation geometry summarized by country and task. The complete 154-row fold-level source table is supplied separately; buffer exclusions are summed across folds, not unique stations.

Table S6. Native monthly SatPM comparison support. Each row is one model specification; observations are reused across MET and update-policy specifications. All 12 cells use the native 0.1° V6GL03 monthly product; no 2025 product was substituted.

Table S7. Portugal training-only retransformation diagnostics conducted after the extreme score was observed. Factors were reproduced under matched source data, split assignments, training support, and model settings; diagnostics did not select a replacement model.

Supplementary Table S8. OC tracer consistency in 2023. Strict QA, P90 fire gate, and log-smear branch; parameter/method series are separate. PM training ended in 2022 and excluded PM sites within 10 km of any OC site. N/sites denotes matched station-month pairs/stations. Intervals use station resampling with fitted predictions fixed. OC is nonspecific, and these correlations do not establish smoke mass.

Supplementary Table S9. Primary historical station-grouped validation. Strict QA, HGB, log-smear target with smearing retransformation, full feature arm. N/sites denotes held-out station-months/physical stations; periods and task-specific eligibility criteria are reported in Supplementary Data. AUS represents Queensland. RMSE is in µg m⁻³. No MET and With MET are prespecified profiles.

Supplementary Table S10. Fixed-window future validation of the full model. All models trained through 2022; primary source policies, strict QA, HGB and log-smear/smearing. N/sites denotes held-out station-months/stations. The 2023 period had been examined before final evaluation, whereas protocols for later-year evaluations were fixed before their final scores were examined. RMSE and signed bias are in µg m⁻³.
Supplementary Table S11. Fixed-window future risk by fire-month stratum. Strict HGB full model with log-smear/smearing; no rolling rows are included. High fire denotes the P90 fire-feature proxy.

Supplementary Table S12. P90 fire-proxy support under fixed-window primary distance rules. Counts show eligible, retained and excluded rows/sites; retained fraction is retained rows divided by eligible rows. Rules combine the 50-km distance screen with non-geographic min–max or P01–P99 feature bounds. Rolling evaluations are excluded. Excluded sites are eligible sites with no retained high-fire-proxy month, not all sites with at least one excluded month.

Supplementary Table S13. Primary 90% station-level conformal intervals by country, task and meteorological profile. Coverage is pooled from summed fold numerators and denominators; mean interval width is weighted by test rows, and unbounded widths remain infinite.
Supplementary Table S14. Portuguese T1 strict-HGB full-model performance across three target/back-transform branches. All branches use the same 434 station-months from 16 stations.

Supplementary Table S15. Full-model comparison with the true monthly SatPM V6GL03 product on identical matched station-months. RMSE differences are full minus SatPM with site-bootstrap 95% intervals; SatPM is a monitor-calibrated comparator, not independent measurement truth.
